title: Umphakathi Owadelela Usuku Lokuphumula
intro: Ngena endaweni yokuhlala esogwini lapho umyalo kaNkulunkulu wabeka eceleni usuku olulodwa lokukhulekela nokuzibamba. Iqembu ngaphakathi kwalomphakathi lakhetha ukuhlola imingcele yalowo myalelo ngecebo lobuqili, okwaholela ekuguqulweni okwakuzozwakala eminyakeni eminingi. Yayingobani le miphefumulo, futhi kwenzekani ngayo?
clues: Sasihlala eduze nogu, lapho ulwandle lwalusihlinzeka khona ngokuziphilisa.
Sasiyalwa ukuba sihloniphe usuku olulodwa lwesonto, silubeke eceleni ezintweni zezwe.
Ngalolo suku, izinhlanzi zeza kithi ngobuningi, njengokungathi zisilinga ukuba seqe umyalo.
Sakha isu lokubamba izinhlanzi ngobusuku bangaphambi kosuku olungcwele, bese siziqoqa uma sezidlulile.
Lapho abanye phakathi kwethu besixwayisa ngaleli qhinga, sazishaya indiva izeluleko zabo futhi saqhubeka.
Ngenxa yokuphambuka kwethu, saguqulwa saba yizinkawu, sadelelwa futhi senqatshwa.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
